# SpectrumElement { #anylumino.SpectrumElement }

```python
SpectrumElement(
    tag,
    children=None,
    *,
    text='',
    label='',
    attributes=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Generic wrapper for rendering a Spectrum custom element.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type     | Description                                                            | Default    |
|------------|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| tag        | required | Spectrum custom element tag name to render.                            | _required_ |
| children   | optional | Child anywidgets or keyed child mapping rendered inside the component. | `None`     |
| text       | optional | Visible text content.                                                  | `''`       |
| label      | optional | Accessible label or visible label, depending on the component.         | `''`       |
| attributes | optional | HTML attributes forwarded to the rendered Spectrum element.            | `None`     |
